actions.action: Perform thermography inspections on PV modules to identify superficial damages caused by severe weather, especially 'vent fort / tempête', and address any hot spots.
actions.expected_impact: Early detection of superficial damages to prevent further deterioration and reduce the risk of severe incidents.

actions.action: Conduct IV-curve tracing tests to detect degradation and short-circuit issues in the wiring, focusing on the DC field.
actions.expected_impact: Identification of wiring degradation before failures occur, minimizing costly repairs and downtime.

actions.action: Schedule regular insulation resistance tests on the DC field to monitor aging and environmental effects on wiring insulation.
actions.expected_impact: Early warning of insulation failures, reducing the likelihood of short circuits and equipment damage.

actions.action: Implement torque checks and tightening of connectors in the DC field, especially in areas exposed to UV and temperature variations.
actions.expected_impact: Reduced connector wear and tear, decreasing the risk of connector failure and associated incidents.

actions.action: Inspect surge protection devices regularly, especially under conditions of moderate wind and clear skies, to ensure proper functioning.
actions.expected_impact: Prevention of surge-related damages, maintaining system reliability.

actions.action: Establish a cleaning schedule for the PV modules and DC field to remove dirt and debris, particularly after moderate rain events.
actions.expected_impact: Maintaining optimal module performance and reducing superficial damage risk.

actions.action: Conduct fire-risk inspections focusing on areas with superficial damages and wiring degradation, especially after severe weather events.
actions.expected_impact: Early detection of fire hazards, enhancing safety and preventing damage.
